sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Release "Credits" tables: the "Via release group" table again shows each release group as a "Release group" with its name in Target, our inline cover art and the big-image strip. jesus2099's "mb. SUPER MIND CONTROL" puts a small cover-art link in front of every release-group link. When it had done so before the table was built, that link was taken as the target: the row read "Release", the group's name moved to an extra Details column, a Picard column appeared, and no artwork was shown. Such an icon link is now skipped (also on the event page, which shares the parser).
